Results.ReviewText: This compact grill provides superior food preparation to larger units. There is plenty of surface area to cook for a large group, and the upper shelf is where I cook veggies or keep meat warm. The grill reaches cooking heat quickly and the heat is constant during use. The air flow through the grill gives a smoked flavor to some meats (pork, chicken, venison) that other grills can't provide. The constant cooking temp is provided by a fuel-efficient propane system. It even tells you--accurately--how much fuel remains. This Weber has made grilling an enjoyable experience again.

Love our Weber grill!  Our old Weber had finally died after about 12 years and we bought another, cheaper  brand that we had about 18 months. What a mistake!  Hated it!  Saved up and bought a Spirit II. And so glad we did. It’s a great grill, OUTSTANDING warranty and customer service. Will never buy another brand (and might never have to buy another grill!). One of the side tables got bent in a storm and Weber replaced it free, no questions asked. We didn’t even pay shipping. It is definitely worth the extra $$ to go with Weber.  
We grill several times a week and at least once a week in the Iowa winter. I would definitely recommend this grill, get the next size up if you grill for a lot of people at once. It’s perfect for 2-4 people, but when all our kids are all home I could use more grilling space. (We have 5). 
I am a mom approaching 60, and I put this together myself only needing help to lift the grill onto the base-it was pretty easy to assemble but takes some time.

Hi Dave! We are sorry to hear that the hose & regulator of your grill was leaking. If the leak was located behind the black knob, it is indeed possible for the tank gasket to be damaged and cause the leak, instead of the actual hose being the culprit.

Results.ReviewText: I received the grill as a gift; connected an existing tank and immediately heard a gas leak.  When I contacted Weber I was questioned which brand tank I used.  Then I was told I should have purchased a new tank, that using an existing one caused the regulator (made in CHINA) to fail.  Two months later I am still waiting for a replacement regulator to arrive.  In the interim, I spoke with two longstanding VAR's of Weber products.  Both stated in 25+ years they have never encountered this and challenged the validity of the statement that an old tank caused the issue.  This is my fifth and last Weber product.  Not impressed with the customer service.  Sorry Weber, you asked for my feedback.
Results.Title: Bad regulator / Bad Support

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Just What I wanted. I have gone through numerous gas grills during the past few years. I always bought what I thought was a good deal. It turned out most weren't. I finally decided to bite the bullet and spend a little more for a Weber. That turned out to be a good decision. I was very pleased right out of the box.  Having used Weber charcoal grills for years, I was very aware of the quality that they build into their products. And if something does break or wear out, replacement parts are easy to get. My only regret is that I waited so long.
Results.Title: Just What I Was Looking for

Results.ReviewText:
While Weber grills are decent this model will never replace my genesis gold of 20 years ago as it is a solid Grill body with stainless grates and is like new without a drop of rust on the body the only thing that I ever had to replace was the bun warmer grate.
My main issue is that the side walls are to low to effectively place a chicken or roast on the rotisserie .

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Sturdy well built, appears to be made of  much higher quality materials than the comp grills. Missing a few bells and whistles of their higher end models. Gets surprisingly hot, no problems getting above 500, with even heat. I would recommend this product to those who want a quality grill, sure to last many year's, at an affordable price.
Results.Title: Best grill around anywhere near this price!

Results.ReviewText: Great Weber product as usual. Cooks to perfection.
Results.Title: Weber is the best

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Bought this as a replacement for a long-owned, larger propane grill. This is the perfect size. Outstanding performance with no wasteful frills. 

Mine was a display model and when I got it home I went through the assembly steps to tighten all connections and make sure that everything was good to go. Unfortunately, I discovered that there were some missing parts. A call to Weber Customer Service resulted in a FedEx delivery days later with everything that I needed.

Great product! Great service!
Results.Title: Great, just great!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The best entry level Weber on the market. It works like a champ and heats up really quick.  I have been using all different brands of grills and this is my first Weber. I am very happy with the it. The build quality is amazing and it's work horse.
Results.Title: Amazing grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
